title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-24
content:
Meeting: Exec Staff Weekly
Date: 2026-03-24
Owner: Claire Morrison
Purpose: Align exec priorities, decide on Dedicated capacity commit thresholds, approve canary plan for batching rollout, review top customer escalations and hiring priorities.

Agenda:
1) Quick round 	6 5m
   - One-line updates from each function (product, engineering, SRE, sales, finance, customer success)
2) Metrics snapshot 	6 10m
   - Hosted API P50 latency, P95 latency, cost/token trend
   - Dedicated utilization and backlog (capacity vs committed)
   - Sales: ARR from Dedicated pipeline
3) Batching/Canary rollout decision 	6 15m
   - Approve staging canary (10% of traffic) for new batching heuristics
   - Rollback criteria and telemetry checks
4) Private deployment pipeline (on-prem) 	6 10m
   - Timeline for 3 pilot customers, infra checklist
5) Customer escalations & SLAs 	6 10m
   - Top 3 escalations, status, required exec support
6) Hiring & org ask 	6 5m
   - Prioritization for SRE headcount vs infra eng
7) AOB / parking lot 	6 5m

Metrics snapshot (prep notes):
- Hosted API: P50=60ms (improved), P95=420ms (small increase due to longer seq requests)
- Cost per 1k tokens: $0.095 last week, target $0.085 (Optimize recommendations pending)
- Dedicated utilization: 72% avg, backlog 18 hours for new capacity spin-up
- Sales pipeline: $6.4M ARR in Dedicated pipeline; expected closes Q2: $1.8M
- Private: 3 pilots signed (NDAs in place), target first on-prem pilot deploy 2026-04-15

Key discussion items & background:
- Batching rollout: New heuristic reduces per-token cost by ~12% in internal tests, but increases tail latency for sequences >4096 tokens. Proposal: Stage 10% traffic on hosted API with fallback to current config if P95 > 2x baseline or error rate delta > 0.5%.
- Dedicated capacity commitments: Sales requests flexible start dates vs engineering request for minimum 3-week lead time. Need decision on commit windows and ability to offer limited burst capacity.
- Private/on-prem: Customers ask for improved KMS integration and audit logging retention. Needs engineering priority and budget approval for on-prem packaging work.

Risks:
- Rollout could cause regressions for long-sequence workloads (LLM-based document ingestion customers).
- If dedicated demand exceeds forecast, we may miss SLA for new customers without urgent capacity procurement.
- Hiring lag: open SRE reqs at 60 days, risk to reliability workstream.

Decision requests (to vote on during meeting):
- Approve batching canary at 10% traffic (yes/no)
- Approve offering 2-week soft start window for Dedicated customers (yes/no)
- Allocate $150k one-time for on-prem packaging and KMS integrations for pilot (approve/reject)

Suggested playbook for canary:
- Duration: 2 weeks
- Traffic split: 10% random, pinned cohorts for known low-risk customers
- Monitoring: P50/P95, error rate, 95th-token-per-second, customer complaints flagged in CS queue
- Rollback triggers: P95 > 2x baseline for 4 consecutive 5m windows OR error delta > 0.5% sustained for 30m OR one SEV affecting >3 customers

Action items (owner 	6 due):
- Alex Chen 	6 implement canary split + telemetry dashboards (2026-03-25)
- Priya Raman 	6 draft customer-facing comms for staged rollout (2026-03-25)
- Samir Patel 	6 confirm Dedicated capacity procurement timeline with cloud partners (2026-03-26)
- Morgan Lee 	6 prioritize on-prem KMS work with applied-ml and infra (proposal 2026-03-27)
- Claire Morrison 	6 coordinate exec-level outreach for two at-risk customers (2026-03-25)

Follow-ups for next week:
- Verify early telemetry from canary (if approved) and short daily sync for first 72 hours
- Update on Dedicated pipeline conversion rate and any necessary trade-offs
- Hiring update: shortlist for SRE candidates

Notes to self:
- Bring up pricing flexibility for mid-market Dedicated customers during sales cadence review
- Ask finance if $150k can be reallocated from Q1 discretionary vs create a special one-time budget
- Confirm legal has reviewed new NDAs for pilot customers

Attachments / links (for meeting):
- Internal benchmark doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/infra-batching-benchmarks
- Sales pipeline deck: https://drive.redwood.ai/sales/pipeline-q2
- Recent customer backlog doc: JIRA-DSK-4123

Prep checklist (before meeting):
- [ ] Alex to share dashboards link
- [ ] Priya to circulate comms draft
- [ ] Samir to confirm procurement lead times
- [ ] Morgan to send short spec for KMS work
